0.original: Ourdilic is seeking aid for a rescue attempt.

1.original: One of the researchers at Snowcloak has not yet returned from collecting ice samples, and he has a reputation for attracting ice sprites. Ourdilic bids you find the hapless man, and if necessary, rescue him from attackers.

2.original: Ourdilic proves to be impressively correct in her surmise, for you come across the whey-faced researcher cringing from the ice sprite. Now that you have slain the sprite and extricated yourself from the researcher's fawning attentions, you must make your report to Ourdilic.

3.original: Ourdilic has a spot of good news for you as well; she has nipped in the bud the researcher's hopes for a <hex:020816E905FF08726F6D616E6365FF0962726F6D616E636503>. A happy ending for everyone─except the ice sprite, of course.

48.original: Never has the course of research run smooth at Snowcloak. We are bedeviled by ice sprites, for one.

49.original: I suspect the sprites are to blame for our latest problem─a researcher on a sample-drilling duty is late returning to camp.

50.original: The sprites delight in tormenting some more than others, and, well, he's just one of those fellows. Will you rush to his rescue?

51.original: You <hex:021A020203>saved<hex:021A020103> me! <hex:02083AE905FF1E49207468696E6B2049276D20696E206C6F7665207769746820796F7521FF17596F75277265206D79206265737420667269656E642103> Let us return to the camp together─oh, you have something dangerous to do first? Um, all right. I'll just...see you later!

53.original: Welcome back, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I just spoke with that whey-face. I made certain he understands you are a busy <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03>, also.

54.original: Thanks to you, we too can busy ourselves with our mission! There will still be much hardship, but with your help, we <hex:021A020203>shall<hex:021A020103> find a way through the ice wall!

55.original: You sense a sudden chill in the air!
